cohort: 190 women who were beneficiaries of the Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA) in a rural block of Purba-Bardhaman district, West Bengal.
finding: The study found that 65.3% of pregnancies were high-risk, with hypothyroidism, previous Caesarean-section, and pregnancy-induced hypertension identified as the leading contributing factors.
mod_finding: Previous Caesarean-section was a significant contributor, accounting for 14.2% of high-risk pregnancies.
